notes: RESOLVED 2026-07-04 — the parent-too-young flag (age 10 at the 1682 birth of listed child Elizabeth Whitlock, I182541959080) is a mis-attached child, not an error in Anne's own birth year. The Elizabeth Whitlock who married William Paullin (I182541959101) of Bucks Co., Pennsylvania, and mothered Henry Paullin (I182541958181, b. 1715, Pilesgrove, Salem Co., NJ) is independently documented — WikiTree profile Whitlock-104, 'Elizabeth (Whitlock) Paullin,' citing Elmer Garfield Van Name's 1958 published genealogy 'The Paullin Family of Southern New Jersey' — as born c. 1695 in Bucks County, Pennsylvania to unknown parents, with no English origin or Atlantic crossing recorded anywhere. No marriage, emigration, or any other record ties Anne Henley or John William Whitlock (I182541959142) to colonial Pennsylvania/New Jersey. This whole English Henley/Whitlock branch carries zero source citations in the underlying tree data and could not be independently confirmed or refuted on the open web (17th-century Suffolk/Wiltshire/Northamptonshire parish registers are subscription/archive-gated). No duplicate-person entry for John William Whitlock was found anywhere in this repo's backlog despite a note suggesting one might exist — none does. Full write-up: docs/research/ancestors/gen11-anne-henley.md.
